_about: Video styles offered to the user (styles) and the single shots they are built from (shots). video.py reads this file; edit it to add a style. A shot is one continuous MiniMax clip of 5 to 10 seconds. who: model (one person wearing the product), none (product only, no people), hands (hands only), team (several people in the same kit), process (factory work, no finished garment). {noun} is the product noun, {sport} the sport, {feature} the feature to demonstrate, {detail} the detail in focus. from_photo: the shot opens on the lead photo itself, so with the look 'Same as my photo' and a photo of the right shape, the photo is used as the opening frame unchanged.

styles.name: 360° turn
styles.pitch: The model turns slowly on the spot, so buyers see front, sides and back in one take.
styles.best_for: Every garment. The best all-round listing video: Etsy, Alibaba, website product pages.

styles.name: Runway walk
styles.pitch: The model walks towards the camera, pauses, turns to show the back and walks away.
styles.best_for: Fashion, streetwear, outerwear, dresses. Instagram and TikTok.

styles.name: Lookbook poses
styles.pitch: The model moves through three or four natural poses while the camera slowly pushes in.
styles.best_for: Streetwear, casual wear, hoodies, jackets. Brand pages and Reels.

styles.name: Street style
styles.pitch: A candid tracking shot of the model walking through a city street, like a street-style photo coming to life.
styles.best_for: Streetwear, sneakers-and-hoodie outfits, jackets. TikTok and Reels.

styles.name: Sport in action
styles.pitch: The kit worn doing the sport it is made for: a footballer dribbling, a boxer shadowboxing, a runner sprinting.
styles.best_for: Teamwear, fightwear, activewear, cycling and gym wear. Shows fit and movement.

styles.name: Detail close-ups
styles.pitch: Slow macro camera moves over the fabric, stitching, prints, zips and labels. No people.
styles.best_for: Showing make quality to wholesale buyers: Alibaba, B2B websites, catalogues.

styles.name: Mannequin 360°
styles.pitch: Your own mannequin photo comes to life: the mannequin turns a full circle on its stand in front of the same background while the camera stays still.
styles.best_for: Factories and shops that photograph garments on a mannequin. Etsy, Alibaba and website product pages. A back photo keeps the back accurate.

styles.name: Flat lay walk-around
styles.pitch: Filmed like a seller's phone video: the camera starts above the flat-laid product, glides down to a low angle, circles it and skims close over the fabric and prints.
styles.best_for: Reels, WhatsApp catalogues and wholesale buyers. Works from your own flat-lay photo, or from product photos (the product is laid flat for you).

styles.name: Hands-on flat lay
styles.pitch: Hands come into frame, lift the collar to show the label, run a thumb over the stitching, flip the hem to show the inside, then smooth it flat again.
styles.best_for: Showing make quality to Alibaba and B2B buyers; Reels for wholesale sellers.

styles.name: Unfold reveal
styles.pitch: The product starts neatly folded; hands unfold it and spread it out to reveal the full print.
styles.best_for: Launches, Etsy and Instagram. Big front prints and graphics.

styles.name: Unboxing
styles.pitch: A plain mailer box on a table: hands open it, fold back the tissue, lift the product out and hold it up to the camera.
styles.best_for: D2C brands, TikTok and Reels ads, gift and premium products.

styles.name: Light sweep
styles.pitch: The camera stays still above the flat lay while a beam of light sweeps across it, making texture, embroidery and reflective prints shine.
styles.best_for: Techwear, reflective prints, embroidery and premium fabrics. Website heroes.

styles.name: Packed for shipment
styles.pitch: Hands fold the product neatly, slide it into a polybag with a size sticker and place it in a carton.
styles.best_for: Manufacturers showing packing quality to wholesale buyers: Alibaba, B2B websites, LinkedIn.

styles.name: Hero reveal
styles.pitch: The garment floats on an invisible form and turns slowly under a spotlight with light haze. Premium and dramatic.
styles.best_for: New drops and launches, premium jackets and jerseys, website heroes. No model needed.

styles.name: Performance test
styles.pitch: Shows one feature working in close-up: water beading off a jacket, a fabric stretching, wind on a shell.
styles.best_for: Outerwear, rainwear, activewear, compression and technical fabrics.

styles.name: UGC try-on
styles.pitch: A phone-camera mirror try-on: the wearer shows the fit, turns and looks pleased. Feels like a real customer post.
styles.best_for: TikTok and Reels ads, D2C brands, casual wear and activewear.

styles.name: Team walk-out
styles.pitch: A squad in the same kit walks out of the tunnel towards the camera, shoulder to shoulder.
styles.best_for: Teamwear and club kits. Shows the kit as a set. Faces may vary between players.

styles.name: Flat lay to worn
styles.pitch: Opens on the garment laid flat from above, then cuts to the model wearing it. Two shots.
styles.best_for: Etsy and Instagram. Shows the product as it arrives and as it looks on.

styles.name: Made in our factory
styles.pitch: A short manufacturing story: cutting, stitching, printing or embroidery, quality check, then the finished garment on a model.
styles.best_for: Manufacturers selling to brands and wholesalers: Alibaba, B2B websites, LinkedIn.

styles.name: Colourway parade
styles.pitch: Quick shots of the same design in each colourway, one after another.
styles.best_for: Products that come in several colours. Needs a front photo for each colourway.

turn.opening: the model stands centred in the frame, full body from head to toe, facing the camera, arms relaxed at the sides
turn.action: The model turns slowly on the spot through one full circle at an even pace: front, left side, back, right side, and ends facing the camera again. The feet stay on the same spot. Calm, confident expression.
turn.camera: Locked-off camera at chest height; the whole body stays in frame the entire time

runway.opening: the model stands at the far end of a straight walkway, full body, facing the camera
runway.action: The model walks towards the camera with a confident, natural stride, stops close to the camera, pauses for a beat, turns to show the back of the {noun}, then walks away.
runway.camera: Camera at waist height on the centre line, slowly pulling back as the model approaches; full body in frame

poses.opening: the model stands three-quarter on to the camera, full body, one hand in a pocket
poses.action: The model moves naturally through three relaxed poses, holding each for about two seconds: hands in pockets looking at the camera, adjusting the collar or cuff of the {noun}, looking back over the shoulder.
poses.camera: Slow, smooth push-in from full body to three-quarter length

street_walk.opening: the model walks along a pavement towards the camera, full body
street_walk.action: The model walks casually along the street towards the camera, glances to the side, then back at the camera. Natural arm swing; the {noun} moves naturally with the walk.
street_walk.camera: Handheld-style tracking shot walking backwards in front of the model, slight natural sway, full body to three-quarter length

action.opening: an athlete wearing the {noun} in a ready stance for {sport}, full body
action.action: The athlete performs a few seconds of {sport} with real, powerful movement at full speed, then settles and looks towards the camera. The {noun} moves and stretches naturally with the body.
action.camera: Dynamic camera following the movement at a slight low angle; the athlete stays fully in frame

action_close.opening: a medium close-up of the athlete wearing the {noun}, catching their breath after {sport}
action_close.action: The athlete breathes hard, wipes the brow with the back of a hand, then looks up at the camera with determination.
action_close.camera: Slow push-in from chest-up to a close-up

detail.opening: an extreme close-up of the {detail} of the {noun}, the garment laid neatly on a flat surface
detail.action: The camera glides slowly across the {noun}, showing the {detail}, the fabric texture and the stitching in sharp detail. Nothing else moves.
detail.camera: Macro lens, very slow lateral slide with a gentle focus pull; shallow depth of field

detail_hands.opening: a close-up of two hands holding up part of the {noun}, showing the {detail}
detail_hands.action: The hands turn the fabric gently towards the camera and run a thumb over the {detail} and the stitching, showing the texture.
detail_hands.camera: Close-up, slow and steady, shallow depth of field; only hands and garment in frame, no faces

mannequin_spin.opening: the {noun} on the mannequin exactly as in the first product photo, the whole mannequin and garment centred in the frame, facing the camera
mannequin_spin.action: The mannequin turns slowly on its stand through one full circle at an even pace: front, side, back, other side, and ends facing the camera again. Only the mannequin and the {noun} turn; the {noun} stays on it without moving or changing shape. The background, floor and light do not move or change.
mannequin_spin.camera: Completely still, locked-off camera; no zoom, no pan

ghost_spin.opening: the {noun} floating in mid-air on an invisible form, as if worn by an invisible person, centred, front facing the camera
ghost_spin.action: The {noun} turns slowly through one full circle, showing the front, the side, the back and the front again. Light haze drifts through the beam of light. No person, mannequin or hanger is visible.
ghost_spin.camera: Locked-off camera, the garment centred and fully in frame

feature.opening: a close-up of the {noun} being worn, showing the {feature}
feature.action: In close-up, the {feature} is demonstrated clearly and realistically, then the camera eases back to show the wearer in the {noun}.
feature.camera: Close-up that slowly pulls back to a medium shot

mirror.opening: the model stands in front of a full-length mirror holding a phone, the reflection shows the full outfit
mirror.action: Filmed as a mirror selfie: the model shows off the {noun}, turns side to side, pulls the hem to show the fit, smiles and gives a small approving nod.
mirror.camera: Phone-camera look, vertical, slight handheld movement, natural indoor daylight

walkout.opening: four players in identical {noun} kits stand shoulder to shoulder at the mouth of a players' tunnel
walkout.action: The players walk out of the tunnel together towards the camera with determined faces, in step, and stop in a line. Every player wears the same kit.
walkout.camera: Low-angle camera pulling back slowly as the team walks forward

flatlay.opening: the {noun} laid perfectly flat and neatly folded at the sleeves, seen from directly above
flatlay.action: The camera slowly descends towards the garment and rotates a few degrees, revealing the fabric texture. Nothing else moves.
flatlay.camera: Top-down overhead camera, slow descent and gentle rotation

hero_close.opening: a waist-up medium shot (the frame cuts at the waist, legs not visible) of the model wearing the {noun} exactly as in the cast image, standing still, looking at the camera
hero_close.action: The model gives a small confident smile and a slight turn of the shoulders, holding the final pose.
hero_close.camera: Slow push-in from medium shot to chest-up

colorway.opening: the model stands facing the camera, full body, wearing the {noun} in the {colorway} colourway
colorway.action: The model turns a quarter to the left and back to face the camera, showing the {colorway} colourway of the {noun}.
colorway.camera: Locked-off camera, full body in frame

process_cut.setting: a bright, clean garment factory cutting room with long tables and rolls of fabric
process_cut.opening: a worker's hands guide a cutting machine along a marker laid over stacked layers of {fabric}
process_cut.action: The cutting blade moves smoothly along the pattern lines through the stacked fabric layers; cut pieces are lifted and stacked neatly.
process_cut.camera: Close-up at table height, slow tracking alongside the cutter

process_sew.setting: a bright, clean garment factory sewing floor with rows of industrial sewing machines
process_sew.opening: a close-up of an industrial sewing machine needle and a worker's hands guiding panels of {fabric}
process_sew.action: The machine stitches a straight, even seam as the hands feed the fabric through at a steady pace; the camera eases back to show rows of machinists at work.
process_sew.camera: Macro close-up of the needle, then a slow pull back

process_decorate.setting: a bright, clean garment factory decoration room
process_decorate.opening: a close-up of {decoration} being applied to a flat panel of {fabric}
process_decorate.action: The {decoration} process runs smoothly and realistically in close-up; the finished panel is lifted to show the result.

process_check.setting: a bright quality-control table in a garment factory
process_check.opening: a quality inspector's hands lay a finished {noun} on a white inspection table
process_check.action: The inspector checks the seams and the print with a measuring tape, smooths the garment and folds it neatly.

flatlay_walk.opening: the {noun} laid perfectly flat on {surface}, seen from directly above, exactly as in the first product photo
flatlay_walk.action: Filmed handheld like a phone video: the camera starts directly above the {noun}, slowly lowers to a low angle and glides around one side of it, then skims close over the fabric, the prints and the stitching. The {noun} does not move.
flatlay_walk.camera: Handheld phone-style camera, smooth with a slight natural sway

flatlay_hands.opening: the {noun} laid perfectly flat on {surface}, seen from above at a slight angle, exactly as in the first product photo, with no hands in the frame yet
flatlay_hands.action: Two hands enter the frame from the bottom edge, gently lift the collar to show the neck label, run a thumb along a seam to show the stitching, flip up the hem for a moment to show the inside, then smooth the {noun} flat again and leave the frame. Only hands and forearms are visible; the {noun} keeps its shape and prints.
flatlay_hands.camera: Steady overhead three-quarter angle with a slow push-in

flatlay_unfold.opening: the {noun} neatly folded into a square on {surface}, seen from above, part of its front print visible
flatlay_unfold.action: Two hands unfold the {noun} one fold at a time and spread it out flat, revealing the full front; the hands smooth it out and leave the frame. At the end the {noun} lies flat exactly as in the product photos.
flatlay_unfold.camera: Locked top-down camera, the whole {noun} in frame when unfolded

unboxing.opening: a closed plain kraft mailer box with no printing on {surface}, seen from a high three-quarter angle
unboxing.action: Two hands open the box lid, fold back white tissue paper, lift the {noun} out by the shoulders and hold it up to the camera so the front is fully visible. Only hands and forearms are visible.
unboxing.camera: High three-quarter angle that tilts up gently as the {noun} is lifted

flatlay_light.opening: the {noun} laid perfectly flat on {surface} in soft low light, seen from directly above, exactly as in the first product photo
flatlay_light.action: The camera does not move. A soft beam of light sweeps slowly across the {noun} from one side to the other, raking across the fabric so the texture, stitching, embroidery and prints catch the light, then the even light returns. The {noun} does not move.

packing.setting: a clean packing table in a bright garment factory dispatch area
packing.opening: the {noun} laid flat on a clean white packing table, a clear polybag and an open cardboard carton beside it
packing.action: Two hands fold the {noun} neatly in thirds, slide it into the clear polybag, press a small blank size sticker on the bag and place it into the carton. Only hands and forearms are visible.

etsy.name: Etsy listing video
etsy.note: Etsy accepts 5 to 15 seconds, up to 100 MB, and removes the sound.

alibaba.name: Alibaba.com product video
alibaba.note: Check the current video limits in Alibaba Seller Center when uploading.
